subject: cut and choose games
statement: The paper proves that the limit version G^candc_{<λ}(B) is consistently determined for all complete Boolean algebras B and all successor cardinals λ, assuming the consistency of a proper class of supercompact cardinals.

subject: cut and choose games
statement: The paper shows that undetermined instances of the game G^candc_λ(B) follow from the approachability property.

subject: cut and choose games
statement: The paper proves that undetermined instances of cut and choose games are compatible with MM^++.

subject: forcing lim^1 A ≠ 0
statement: The paper develops methods for forcing lim^1 A ≠ 0, where A is an inverse system of abelian groups from Mardesic and Prasolov's computation of strong homology groups.

subject: nonvanishing lim^k A
statement: The paper shows that it is relatively consistent with ZFC that b = d = ω_n and lim^k A ≠ 0 for 1 ≤ k ≤ n.

subject: nonvanishing lim^k A
statement: The paper shows that it is relatively consistent with ZFC that b = d = ω_{ω+2} and lim^k A ≠ 0 for all k ≥ 1.

subject: lim^1 A in forcing extensions
statement: The paper shows that lim^1 A = 0 holds in many finite support iterated forcing extensions.

subject: equivariant Weierstrass theorem
statement: The paper proves that there exists a Borel map assigning to each non-periodic positive divisor Λ an entire function F_Λ such that the divisor of zeroes is Λ and F_{Λ-w}(z) = F_Λ(z+w).

subject: equivariant Weierstrass theorem
statement: The paper shows that non-periodicity cannot be omitted in the equivariant Weierstrass theorem.

subject: equivariant Weierstrass theorem
statement: The paper shows that Borel measurability cannot be strengthened to continuity in the equivariant Weierstrass theorem.

subject: many-one degrees and one-one degrees
statement: The paper generalizes Batyrshin's result to all nonrecursive and nonirreducible many-one degrees, showing that infinite antichains of one-one degrees can always be embedded.

subject: many-one degrees
statement: The paper solves Odifreddi's open problem on whether infinite antichains can always be embedded in nonrecursive and nonirreducible many-one degrees.

subject: reducibilities in recursion theory
statement: The paper studies finite-one and bounded finite-one reducibilities to deepen the study of reducibilities between one-one and many-one in recursion theory.

subject: Sacchetti's modal logics
statement: The paper provides an effective cut elimination procedure for Sacchetti's logics, solving an open problem of Iwata.

subject: Sacchetti's modal logics
statement: The paper introduces a new non-wellfounded sequent calculus for Sacchetti's logics with an improved subformula property.

subject: Sacchetti's modal logics
statement: The paper proves that Sacchetti's logics have the uniform Lyndon interpolation property.

subject: Boolean hyperdoctrines
statement: The paper exhibits a non-full Boolean hyperdoctrine, showing that not all Boolean hyperdoctrines satisfy the generalized Beck-Chevalley condition.

subject: Boolean hyperdoctrines
statement: The paper shows that every Boolean hyperdoctrine FinSet → BA over FinSet^op is full.

subject: tolerant learning for c.e. sets
statement: The paper develops a generalization called tolerant learning in which correctness is determined by an arbitrary equivalence relation on indices of c.e. sets.

subject: tolerant learning
statement: The paper introduces a new degree structure, the tolerant learning hierarchy, obtained by comparing tolerance relations according to the families they make learnable.

subject: tolerant learning
statement: The paper shows that the tolerant learning hierarchy is a bounded lower semilattice but not an upper semilattice, is atomless and coatomless, and contains chains and antichains of size continuum.

subject: tolerant learning
statement: The paper separates non-effective from computable tolerant learning by exhibiting a universal relation that is not computably universal.

subject: preorders on commutative monoids
statement: The paper presents a constructive description of all total preorders on finitely generated commutative monoids that are compatible with the monoid structure.

subject: preorders on commutative monoids
statement: The paper shows that preorders on a commutative monoid form an irreducible spectral space covered by countable union of admissible sets.

subject: commutative monoids with order
statement: The paper shows that the universal theory of commutative monoids with a total order is decidable.

subject: complex curves in o-minimal geometry
statement: The paper shows that cohomology of noncompact curves in o-minimal structures is concentrated entirely at punctures.

subject: o-minimal structures
statement: The paper computes the cohomology of the structure sheaf on the affine line in o-minimal geometry.

subject: definable Riemann surfaces
statement: The paper characterizes which definable Riemann surfaces have definable compactifications in o-minimal geometry.

subject: separable Banach lattices
statement: The paper introduces two Polish space encodings of separable Banach lattices via closed sublattices of the universal lattice C(Δ;L_1) and closed order ideals of the free Banach lattice.

subject: Banach lattices
statement: The paper proves that spaces of closed sublattices and closed order ideals of a separable Banach lattice are Polish subspaces of the hyperspace of closed subsets.

subject: Fremlin tensor product
statement: The paper proves that the Fremlin projective tensor-product operation on ideal codes is Σ^0_2-measurable and has a G_δ graph.

subject: independence relations
statement: The paper shows that the independence relation ↓^Haar induced by Haar null ideals is a good independence relation for locally compact groups.

subject: independence relations
statement: The paper provides an example showing ↓^Haar ≠ ↓^nm, distinguishing Haar null from non-meager independence.

subject: independence relations
statement: The paper conjectures that ↓^nm is the maximum well-behaved independence relation for Polish groups.

subject: Polish groups
statement: The paper proves that the non-meager independence is maximum for Polish groups under the extra hypothesis of σ-compactness.

subject: nilpotent Lie groups
statement: The paper proves that the independence relation is unique for nilpotent Lie groups.

subject: infinitesimals
statement: The paper constructs an explicit totally ordered field ℝ^{ℤ_<} using only real sequences and Cauchy convolution.

subject: infinitesimals
statement: The paper models the combined real and hyperreal axioms via the Chunk and Permeate strategy, a paraconsistent technique isolating contradictions without global collapse.

subject: infinitesimal calculus
statement: The paper develops a calculus where infinitesimal derivatives and integrals permeate cleanly to their classical counterparts.

subject: infinitesimals
statement: The paper introduces a (k,n)-continuity hierarchy capturing infinitesimal smoothness invisible to standard or transfer-based models.

subject: Grossone arithmetic
statement: The paper yields a direct algebraic consistency proof for Sergeyev's Grossone arithmetic via the constructed field.

subject: models of PA
statement: The paper forces a universe in which every model of PA of size κ (a successor cardinal) extends to a model of the same size with no splendid extensions.

subject: splendid extensions
statement: The paper shows that if there is an ineffable cardinal then the non-existence of splendid extensions holds at some cardinal below it in ZFC.

subject: non-normal modal logics
statement: The paper introduces a new semantics based on closure operators for non-normal modal logics including logics adopting the axiom C.

subject: modal logics
statement: The paper proves modal completeness for several non-normal modal logics with respect to closure operator semantics.

subject: conjunctively closed provability
statement: The paper proves arithmetical completeness theorems for the logics CN, CNP, CNF, CNPF, and CND using closure operator semantics.

subject: discontinuity of multivalued functions
statement: The paper shows that discontinuity on sets with Cantor-Bendixson rank at most α is equivalent to reduction to ACC_N^α.

subject: multivalued functions
statement: The paper characterizes discontinuity properties via a Wadge-style discontinuity game for multivalued functions.

subject: Ramsey theorems
statement: The paper extends the thin set and achromatic Ramsey theorems to ordinal parameters RT^n_{α,β}.

subject: Ramsey theorems
statement: The paper computes the ranks of discontinuity for the ordinal-indexed Ramsey problems RT^n_{α,β}.

subject: quantum logic
statement: The paper classifies the six layers of the free orthomodular lattice on two generators by commutativity, identifying the central kernel of context-neutral propositions.

subject: quantum logic
statement: The paper shows that orthocomplementation rearranges layers exactly as complementation rearranges elements, making layer duality rigid rather than accidental.

subject: quantum logic
statement: The paper proves that forgetting context is a surjective homomorphism of orthocomplemented lattices whose quotient is the classical Boolean algebra.

subject: stable forking conjecture
statement: The paper shows that stability of forking relation over a base in finite-rank supersimple theory is determined by finitely many pregeometries in each rank.

subject: pregeometric interpretation
statement: The paper shows that the set of matroids determining based forking stability in rank n can be chosen to be finite.

subject: S4-subordination algebras
statement: The paper gives a topological representation for S4-subordination algebras by means of bitopological spaces <X, τ, τ_S>.

subject: subordination algebras
statement: The paper shows there exists a bijective correspondence between congruences compatible with subordination and certain closed subsets of the Stone space.

subject: subordination algebra morphisms
statement: The paper provides topological representations for two types of morphisms between S4-subordination algebras.

subject: first-order modal logic in HOL
statement: The paper provides three embeddings of first-order modal logic into classical higher-order logic in Isabelle/HOL: deep, heavyweight-shallow, and lightweight-shallow.

subject: first-order modal logic
statement: The paper presents a global faithfulness theorem stating that quantifying over all minimal-shallow interpretations recovers exactly deep validity.

subject: first-order modal logic
statement: The paper mechanizes the countable downward Löwenheim-Skolem theorem for first-order modal logic under constant-domain Kripke semantics.

subject: modal logic formalization
statement: The paper develops substitution machinery including free/bound-variable predicates, capture-avoiding substitution, and induction principles for first-order quantifiers.
